title: fix(runtime)!: the flow trigger door refuses a params that is not a JSON object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQd91J7V4CWRKjvyX2EBFVK)_
Fixes #25821

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Contract review owed: the `(narrowing)` arm. The trigger doors refuse request shapes they used to dispatch, a `params` that is a string, number, boolean, array or `null`. Nothing is widened, and no `packages/spec/**` path is touched. The seat's claim (6409382263) carries `Clause-②: no`; the line above is the measured value on this diff, declared as the dispatch order asked.

## What changed

`buildAutomationContext` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`) read `params` with `params && typeof params === 'object' ? { ...params } : {}`. A string became an empty bag and the flow ran with no inputs. An array was spread into an index-keyed bag. A falsy value (`null`, `0`, `false`, `""`) took the flat-body branch, which forwarded the body's other top-level keys as params instead.

The builder now refuses a `params` that is not a JSON object, before anything is dispatched: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, one `fields[]` entry `{ field: 'params', code: 'invalid_type' }`, message `Invalid trigger body — params expected an object (a map of names to values), received a string` (the received type varies). It is thrown as the validation failure both dispatcher exits and the endpoint executor already answer as 400.

The check is one function, `objectValueFailure(field, value)`, hoisted out of the resume door's #9416 value-shape loop. The resume door now calls it for `inputs`, `variables` and `output` and the trigger door calls it for `params`, so the two doors of one engine ask the same question in the same words. The resume answers are byte-identical (its suites pass unchanged). The resume arm's local `jsonTypeOf` stays local, as its note asks; only this one refusal is shared.

`undefined` counts as absent, as on the resume door, so a body with no `params` key still takes the flat-body branch. An explicit `null` is refused, as the resume door refuses `{"inputs":null}`.

## Doors measured

| Door | Shares the builder? | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/trigger` | yes, through `respondToFlowTrigger` | refuses |
| `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/:name` (legacy, `client.automation.trigger()`) | yes, same function | refuses |
| A declared `type: 'flow'` API endpoint (`endpoint-executor.ts` `executeFlow`) | yes | refuses |
| `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` on a `type: 'flow'` action | no, it reads `reqBody.params` itself (`domains/actions.ts`) | unchanged, see Acceptance notes |
| Flow-to-flow (`subflow`, `map` nodes) | no, they call `engine.execute` with a built context | not a wire door |
| MCP | no MCP tool starts a flow by name; `verify` calls `execute` in process | not applicable |

Order on the REST doors and the endpoint: an unknown flow still answers `404` and a caller the flow refuses still answers `403`, before the body is judged. The refusal is before `execute()`, so no run starts and no run row is written.

## Evidence

Live, fresh showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`) on this branch at `7f0c45b4`, signed in as the seeded admin:

- `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_notify_owner/trigger` and `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/showcase_notify_owner`, each with `{"params":"oops"}`, `{"params":[1,2]}`, `{"params":null,"ownerId":"u1"}` and `{"params":42}`: all eight answer `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `params` with the received type.
- Control `{"params":{}}` on both routes still dispatches (`400 FLOW_FAILED`, "Unknown variable: ownerId", the flow's own answer with no inputs).
- `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase_notify_owner/runs` afterwards lists 2 runs, the two controls. The eight refused requests left no run row.
- `POST /api/v1/apps/showcase/inquiries/purge` (a declared `type: 'flow'` endpoint) with `{"params":"oops"}`: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `params`.

Tests (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-trigger-params-shape.test.ts`, new, 42 cases):

- Red first: with `automation.ts` restored from base `9ca36b16`, 29 failed / 13 passed (every refusal case red, every preservation case green).
- Green on the fix: 42/42, with the neighbouring suites (resume value-shape, resume envelope, trigger route status, endpoint executor, caller param keys, run locale, anonymous gate): 8 files, 215 tests passed.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `if (paramsFailure) {` to `if (paramsFailure && false) {`, anchor 1 to 0, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): 29 failed / 13 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` at `7f0c45b4`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, 448 test files passed, 7224 tests passed, 19 skipped.

Gates at `7f0c45b4`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 69 families; all 69 exit 0 (three needed the full build or an unshallow fetch first and were rerun after it). `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime`: exit 0. Full `pnpm turbo run build`: 121/121 tasks.

Dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm), full, at `7f0c45b4`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 296 passed / 3 skipped (299), Tests 2523 passed / 18 skipped (2541), no failures.

`origin/main` moved after the merge (10 commits, none touching `domains/automation.ts`, `endpoint-executor.ts` or `http-dispatcher.ts`; `git merge-tree` clean), so this head is not re-merged; CI runs on the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

Two sibling doors drop a non-object value the same way. Neither shares the builder, so neither is touched here; both are reported to the seat with their live readings.

- `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` reads `params` with the same `params && typeof params === 'object'` guard (`domains/actions.ts`). On the fresh boot, `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign` with `{"params":"oops"}` and with `{"params":[1,2]}` each answered `200` and started a paused run, exactly as `{"params":{}}` did.
- The trigger door's body itself is not judged: `ctxBody = body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {}`. A JSON string body `"oops"` dispatched `showcase_notify_owner` with an empty bag (`400 FLOW_FAILED`, "Unknown variable: ownerId"), and an array body `[1,2]` forwarded its indices as params. The resume door refuses a non-object body; the trigger ruling covers `params` only.
